purpose: Mark the destination or direction of movement.
keywords: Place + に / へ + movement verb.
I am going to Kyoto tomorrow.
formation: Place + に / へ + movement verb.
restrictions: へ emphasizes direction and is pronounced え; に also has non-movement uses.
mistake: Do not replace recipient に with へ in every expression.
